Bikes and Brews (formerly the Rollout)

South Bend, IN · Social · Mountain bike · Road

Beginner friendly

Bikes and Brews (formerly the Rollout) is a social, mountain bike and road group ride in South Bend, IN. It rolls every Thursday at 6:30 pm from The old 7-11. Pace: social ride, MTB ride and a faster road ride each week.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social ride, MTB ride and a faster road ride each week.
Check
Look at @connect.574 the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bikes and Brews (formerly the Rollout) group ride

South Bend's Thursday night ride series with three options: a social ride, a mountain bike ride and a faster road ride. Everyone meets up at The Lauber afterward.
